verdict.rationale: The Gateway Requests tab shows every request flowing through the gateway, refreshed every few seconds. An optional Capture payloads toggle stores full request and response bodies per event, which gives enough detail to audit agent activity. Logs and observability are also exposed as MCP tools, and a community member praised the logs feature. Missing for 10: an explicit replay capability, documented retention and export of logs, confirmation that events are broken down per tool call rather than per raw request, and independent hands-on corroboration.
